claims.subject: fvg
claims.claim: The AP-002 fvg authority bundle is unresolved pending source approval: its selected, provenance, and status collections are empty, its unresolved list contains exactly UNRESOLVED_PENDING_SOURCE_APPROVAL, and the bundle manifest lists authority.json as its only generated file for subject fvg on XAUUSD.

authority_evidence.supports: Bundle records empty selected, provenance, and status collections.
Bundle unresolved list is exactly ["UNRESOLVED_PENDING_SOURCE_APPROVAL"].
Bundle is issued for program AP-002, subject fvg, instrument XAUUSD.
authority.json is the only generated file listed in the bundle.

claims.future_information_risk: Source approval or a later bundle is expected to replace the empty selected/provenance/status collections and retire the unresolved flag; the bundle content identity would change if that occurs.
claims.dependency_implications: Every downstream AP-002 fvg activity inherits this gate: nothing is approved until an explicit freeze action, so all claims here bind only within this unresolved state.
claims.notes: Program-level unresolved state preserved verbatim from the bundle.

claims.subject: fvg
claims.claim: The authoritative detector registry entry for fvg is: domain bar, known_surfaces [bar], native_scales explicit [15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h], semantic_status UNRESOLVED, description 'Authoritative bar surface; semantics unresolved.', and empty lifecycle_vocabulary, empty roles, and empty derives_from. Consequently no fvg role classification and no lifecycle state are authoritative in this program.

authority_evidence.supports: Registry records domain=bar, known_surfaces=[bar], semantic_status=UNRESOLVED, description='Authoritative bar surface; semantics unresolved.'
All three arrays are empty for fvg.
Native scales are explicit: 15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h.

claims.future_information_risk: An approved source could populate lifecycle_vocabulary, roles, or derives_from for fvg, which would upgrade specific unresolved topics without invalidating this snapshot of the current registry.
claims.dependency_implications: Until then, no fvg role classification or lifecycle state may be used as an authoritative input to experiments or eligibility decisions.
claims.notes: The registry description is placeholder text, not a semantic definition.

claims.subject: fvg
claims.claim: In the XAUUSD source inventory, every one of the seven bar scales (15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h) carries a physical column named payload_fvg of type LargeUtf8, nullable=true, in each of six parts per scale, with all six parts per scale listed as schema-verified and payload_fvg listed in each scale's payload_columns. The tick scale schema contains no payload_fvg column and no fvg-named payload column of any kind.

authority_evidence.supports: payload_fvg is LargeUtf8 and nullable=true in all seven bar-scale sources.
payload_fvg is listed in the payload_columns of all seven bar scales.
Six of six parts are schema-verified for every bar scale.
The tick schema carries no payload_fvg or fvg-named column; tick payloads are drift_burst, spread_state, quote_dynamics, quote_arrival, micro_volatility, feed_health, quote_pressure.

claims.future_information_risk: A re-issued inventory could add, rename, or repartition payload columns; the facts here bind to the inventoried schema as mounted.
claims.dependency_implications: All fvg object-level analysis must flow through this single nullable serialized column per bar row, on bar surfaces only.
claims.notes: Column existence, type, and nullability are the only physical fvg facts asserted; contents are not established (see AP002-A02-C022).

authority_evidence.supports: Twenty-four fields are enumerated: instrument_id, bar_open_ts, bar_close_ts, open, high, low, close, volume, and sixteen payload columns including payload_fvg; the same field set appears in every bar-scale source.
Each bar row carries exactly two time coordinates, bar_open_ts and bar_close_ts.

claims.subject: fvg
claims.claim: No authoritative lifecycle semantics exist for fvg: the registry entry has an empty lifecycle_vocabulary, no roles, and no state or transition definitions appear on any authorized surface. FORMATION, FIRST_TOUCH, and FILL are requested concepts from the run instructions, not authoritative lifecycle states; no property of them, and no temporal ordering among them (including any claim that fill is definitionally later than touch or formation), may be inferred from the names, from field names, or from ordinary language.

authority_evidence.supports: The authoritative lifecycle vocabulary for fvg is empty.
Lifecycle-first: future completion/termination cannot define an earlier-state cohort; completed may be a later outcome or later anchor.

claims.future_information_risk: Source approval could introduce an authoritative vocabulary, which would resolve this topic directly.
claims.dependency_implications: fvg-anchored experiment contracts lack an authoritative lifecycle_state value (see AP002-A02-C019), and cohort construction must not assume any ordering.
claims.notes: Requested-concepts discipline recorded here applies to the touch and fill topics as well.
